PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS: Task 3 from docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-30-model-role-constraints.md
Assess standard code quality AND:
- Does the new loader code follow the file's existing patterns (how other frontmatter fields like `max_tool_calls` are parsed; how other YAML blocks are parsed; LoadError usage with SourceLoc)?

expected_findings.description: The four new tests use local (inline) imports inside function bodies instead of module-level imports used throughout the rest of the file.
The tmp_path parameter lacks the type annotation (tmp_path: Path) used by all prior tests in the file.
No validation that model_role in agent frontmatter is a non-empty string; code allows str(123) → "123" or empty strings without guards, inconsistent with step-level parsing.
